Messages.Author: The Lasombra
Messages.Body:
After a number of requests, a page summarizing the primary dead horses for this
forum has been created. It is by no means exhaustive, nor does it indicate
that further discussion on these topics is discouraged. It is designed to help
people new to this group get up to speed on the main re-occuring debates so
that they can take the discussions into new territory rather than re-hash the
same 3-4 points that have been made over the last 7 years.

If you have a suggestion about a topic that should be added to the page, email
me the Topic, Suggestion, and Response and I will edit them and add them to the
page.

http://www.thelasombra.com/vtes_focs.htm

Carpe noctem.

Lasombra

http://www.TheLasombra.com

Messages.Author: Andrew S. Davidson
Messages.Body:
On Thu, 1 Nov 2001 00:02:12 +0000 (UTC), The Lasombra wrote:

>After a number of requests, a page summarizing the
>primary dead horses for this forum has been created.

It's too tendentious. Clues like putting "improved" in quotes
immediately tell the reader that this is propaganda.

Anyway, you missed several of the actual common suggestions:

* Artists other than Shy and Snelly should be used for the crypt cards -
their vampires all look the same.

* The WW web site should list all the cards whose text has changed so
that we can more easily tell which they are.

* The NRA rules should appear in the rulebook because the game is broken
without them.

* Succubus Club/Temptation of Greater Power/Archon
Investigation/whatever should be banned because it is sick and wrong.

* Weenies/Rush/S&B/5th Trad Bloat/whatever is sleazy, filthy, cheese.
They should be curbed by means of <clever suggestion>.

Andrew

Messages.Author: The Lasombra
Messages.Body:
"Andrew S. Davidson" <a...@csi.com> wrote in message
news:92D803638F240A9D.E9D48D86...@lp.airnews.net...

> On Thu, 1 Nov 2001 00:02:12 +0000 (UTC), The Lasombra wrote:
>
> >After a number of requests, a page summarizing the
> >primary dead horses for this forum has been created.
>
> It's too tendentious. Clues like putting "improved" in quotes
> immediately tell the reader that this is propaganda.

There is no claim anywhere on the page that it isn't biased.
I will change the page title to Propaganda immediately.

> Anyway, you missed several of the actual common suggestions:
>
> * Artists other than Shy and Snelly should be used for the crypt cards -
> their vampires all look the same.

No one reading this newsgroup has any effect on the artists who are
chosen by White Wolf, discussing it or repeating the argument on that
page won't have any effect.

> * The WW web site should list all the cards whose text has changed so
> that we can more easily tell which they are.

There isn't anyone arguing against this. If more different people request
the information be added to White Wolf's site, it will be more likely
to happen.

> * The NRA rules should appear in the rulebook because the game is broken
> without them.

Maybe so.
Write up both sides of the argument in a non-biased manner and I will
add it to the page.

> * Succubus Club/Temptation of Greater Power/Archon
> Investigation/whatever should be banned because it is sick and wrong.

This is what I am looking for. Write up both sides of the argument in a
non-biased manner and I will add it to the page.

> * Weenies/Rush/S&B/5th Trad Bloat/whatever is sleazy, filthy, cheese.
> They should be curbed by means of <clever suggestion>.

As the suggestion most frequently is a card limit, I believe it has
been covered. If you have another, write up both sides of the argument
in a non-biased manner and I will add it to the page.

I only add non-biased to all the requirements because it means so much to you.
If you discuss both sides thoroughly, presenting the arguments that both
sides have put forth, then it doesn't matter to me which one has
the better argument.

When we used to point people to Mark Langsdorf's Card Limit articles,
all the points they were making were discussed in those articles, but
they didn't bother to read them. Now all the arguments are in one
file, and their excuses are a lot less. It also is very easy to see
what arguments one side or the other has already used, and expand on
that argument or use a different one completely.

Messages.Author: The Fanboy
Messages.Body:
> That's quite a nice summary though I'm a bit confused by the cards
> that have multiple entries (e.g. Elysium) and the preamble doesn't
> explain this.

It's used to track the history of the change.

The VTES version clarified that it can only be used by the controller
of one of the two combatants (you can't tap it to end someone else's
combat, as you could with Mariel).

Errata was added in DS allowing only Camarilla vampires to burn the
location (wasn't needed before DS came out, as there were no
non-Camarilla vampires at the time).

Errata was added when Sabbat War came out changing Elysium so that it
only ended combat between two Camarilla Vampires, thus removing it
from many tournament decks. *chuckle* This was, presumably, because
the Sabbat was getting an equivalent card in Purchase Pact.

Fanboy
